relationships.evidence_quote: As IL8 is a high-affinity ligand for CXCR1,27 we used IL8 to activate CXCR1 receptor

key_findings: Spinal CXCR1, mainly in neurons, is upregulated in bone cancer pain and its knockdown relieves allodynia
CXCR1 knockdown reduced p-JAK2/p-STAT3 and NLRP3/caspase-1/IL-1beta in vivo and in PC12 cells
